chunks: The head of wisdom is the fear of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.رَأْسُ الْحِكْمَةِ: the chief foundation and highest principle of wisdom
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: the Mighty and Majestic; an honorific affirming Allah’s exalted greatness
key_terms.مَخَافَةُ اللَّهِ: reverent fear of Allah that leads to obedience and caution

ai.seo_question: What is the foundation of wisdom in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true wisdom begins with reverent fear of Allah, meaning an awareness of His greatness that restrains a person from disobedience. It presents God-consciousness as the essential foundation of sound judgment and upright living.
